name: casting partner evaluator
description: how a platform or distribution partner evaluates a tool for their ecosystem: fit, integration cost, and support risk.

criteria.name: ecosystem fit
criteria.description: the project serves a user the partner cares about

criteria.name: integration cost
criteria.strong_answer: a documented api or embed path

criteria.name: product maturity
criteria.description: stable enough for the partner's users to touch

criteria.name: support and maintenance risk
criteria.description: evidence the project will be maintained
criteria.strong_answer: dated activity and a stated roadmap

criteria.name: no brand risk
criteria.description: nothing in the project embarrasses the partner

red_flags: claims about the partner's platform that are false
objection_seeds: what happens when it breaks for our users
who maintains this in six months
what do we tell users it does
